result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant name and one partially visible category pill.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated/cut off. The full name is not visible due to the card being partially off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure that at least the restaurant name is fully visible or use ellipsis (...) truncation with a tooltip, so users understand they can scroll to see more cards. Alternatively, show a partial card that clearly signals scrollability without cutting off critical text.

issues.description: The last category filter pill (after 'Healthy') is partially cut off on the right side of the horizontal scroll row, showing only a sliver of the next option.
issues.suggestion: This is partially intentional to hint at horizontal scrollability, but the cut-off is too severe. Show at least 30-40% of the next pill to clearly communicate that more options exist while still being readable.
